title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Every position in this record is paper. No real orders are placed anywhere in it. One trade, whether open or closed, says nothing about a strategy, and the live record is a running account of engine state rather than a verdict on future performance. The purpose of this note is to report that state as it stands, without projection.

## Paper signals only
The engines report paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026, and v006 counts its live record from 9 October 2026. htf-rsi-v007 is also part of the live record, with its own position and closed-trade counts. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM then exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. That sequence is one measured path from entry to exit; it records what the rule did, not what any asset must do next. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since, so its result is not yet measured. In testing, a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise, and the average winner was roughly +19%. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.

## Open positions and the most recent closed trade
At the snapshot read at 2026-11-12T08:59:29.706Z, htf-rsi-v007 has 0 positions open on paper and 4 closed trades so far, with an average null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 has 0 positions open on paper and 6 closed trades so far, with an average −13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 has 0 positions open on paper and 7 closed trades so far, with an average −13.34% net per trade. Zero open positions means the paper books for those engines are flat at the snapshot time; the closed counts and averages are historical measurements of completed trades. The NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since, so it is still exposed to price movement and is not included in any closed-trade average. The ATOM trade is the most recent closed example in the narrative: it entered at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close and exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close at 1.703, for −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The exit followed the rule, and the percentage is the measured result after costs.

## Market filter state
trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter off. trend-daily-v006 has the Bitcoin market filter off. With 0 positions open on paper for trend-daily-v005 and 0 positions open on paper for trend-daily-v006, the live record shows no open trend-daily positions at the snapshot time. The filter being off is recorded as part of engine state, alongside those zero open positions. The engines' closest levels to their 20-day breakout are the same for both trend-daily engines: AVAXUSDT is 6.73% below its high, TRXUSDT is 10.05% below its high, and BNBUSDT is 10.54% below its high. AVAXUSDT, TRXUSDT and BNBUSDT are the names closest to their 20-day breakout levels, measured as percentage distance below their highs. Those percentages are distances from a high, not forecasts of whether a breakout will occur.

## Closed-trade averages
The closed-trade averages are measurements of what already happened, not estimates of what will happen. htf-rsi-v007 has 4 closed trades so far with an average null net per trade, so this record does not state a numeric average for those 4 closed trades. trend-daily-v005 has 6 closed trades so far with an average −13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 has 7 closed trades so far with an average −13.34% net per trade. Each average is a backward-looking summary of completed net results. ATOM's single closed result of −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip is one contribution to that kind of average, and it followed the rule that an exit occurs below the 10-day low. NEAR remains open at 5.896 since 12 October 2026, so it is not part of any closed-trade average yet.

## Where to check
The record updates continuously. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. The snapshot used here was read at 2026-11-12T08:59:29.706Z. Because every position in this record is paper, and one trade says nothing about a strategy, the live page should be read as a running state rather than as evidence of future results. If a number in this note differs from those pages, the live record and its timestamp govern the reading.
